name: tag1_standard_three_layer
description: Standard tag1 Jimu build target: base plus two square layers and four triangle roof panels.
notes: The fixed scene is useful for cached simulation.

Tray slots are standardized as triangle slots 4, 5, 6, and 12; all other slots are square slots. Tag1 uses square spare slots 11 and 13. Build layers preserve physical layer order while sorting each layer by tray slot.
The layer_z_extra_m values add cumulative world-Z clearance to every builder layer for real magnetic attachment tolerance.
For live localization, add --jimu-apriltag-anchor-localization; command-line args override this manifest.
